NC_vs_B_source_reasoning.NC_other_instance_invariance: NC replaces every row of each non-target utility matrix with the current posterior-weighted expectation repeated across all structures. Its expectation is then constant over hypothetical branch posteriors, in exact arithmetic.
NC_vs_B_source_reasoning.floating_point_caveat: The repeated-constant matrix multiplication can round differently from an unflattened fixed posterior expectation. No counterfactual run or universal bitwise equivalence is asserted.
NC_vs_B_source_reasoning.interpretation: Both retain the same followup action candidates and their deterministic other-instance utility contributions; only NC admits actual observed peer evidence into current planning beliefs. Thus NC versus B is the declared contrast for current shared reliability belief, while S versus NC tests the cross-instance future component.
NC_vs_B_source_reasoning.nonsharing_branch_independence: B posterior for j != diagnosed i depends only on its own fixed initial mixture prior and evidence. observation_branch changes only evidence_i, so posterior_j is unchanged by the hypothetical observation.

activation_findings.limitation: The removed actual-feedback/shared-evidence mechanism never changed the planning geometry evidence on this history, so this nominal NF contrast has weak discriminatory power.
activation_findings.observed: All B/S/NC/NF/NP have 34 frontend feedback attempts, 18 informative residuals, and zero applied updates. All 34 refusals coincide with no new support and support length 4096. Shared variants have 88 instance-frames with peers, but no peer-adjusted reliability; rho remains 0.5.

activation_findings.limitation: This condition does activate the feedback/shared-belief distinction; its unchanged executed actions and mesh cannot be explained solely by feedback never running.
activation_findings.observed: All five arms have 16 frontend attempts and 8 applied updates. B/S/NC/NP show two planner geometry-evidence change events and 55 nonzero-evidence instance-frames; NF shows zero for both. S/NC/NP have 41 peer-adjusted instance-frames, first at paid step 66, with maximum rho 0.5281456972891215; B/NF stay at rho 0.5.

activation_findings.limitation: Future scoring can change without winning the action competition. Positive logged EVI in NP is a diagnostic quantity, not evidence of future value entering its ranking.
activation_findings.observed: Nominal has 8 diagnostic options with 3 positive total EVI values; shift has 4 options with 1 positive total EVI. NP disables future_information_used in every option and uses the logged before-observation score. First numeric diagnostic divergence from S is step 44 nominal and 74 shifted. None of the ten trajectories selects diagnose_then_observe.

activation_findings.limitation: Cross-future enablement does not produce a distinguishable option-value change on these realized P00 histories. This is local observational equality, not a claim that the component is generally unnecessary.
activation_findings.observed: NC disables the cross-future receipt flag for every diagnostic option. S and NC have identical saved numeric diagnostic option lists, planning beliefs (excluding peer metadata), selected options, actions, poses, targets, and endpoint mesh/occupancy arrays on both P00 conditions.

activation_findings.limitation: All ablation endpoint metrics remain null in this diagnostic pending each target independent replay and proper numeric evaluation/reuse. Saved artifact equality alone does not create a formal score.
activation_findings.observed: All 12 ablation-to-S/B comparisons have identical saved action, macro-target, pose sequences and exact mesh/occupancy files and array content. Every task uses 120 paid actions/121 packets and returns without collision.

capability_checks_scope: Static frozen source definitions plus saved method/configuration hashes and observed receipt invariants. No controller instantiation, replay, or counterfactual evaluation.

counter_definitions.first_difference_witnesses: Exact saved JSON value comparison; a first difference can include floating-point last-bit changes. Positive EVI counts use epsilon.
counter_definitions.peer_adjusted_reliability_instance_frame: Same-class peers present and abs(rho - 0.5) > 1e-12; distinct frames/instances are not independent scene samples.

definitions.B: Ordinary Bayesian comparator uses own feedback and future diagnosis without actual cross-instance reliability sharing.
definitions.NC: Retains actual shared reliability and own-instance future update. Flattens other-instance future gain dependence when evaluating a hypothetical diagnosis; it does not disable actual cross-instance sharing.
definitions.NF: Disables actual geometry evidence in planning structural belief; shared frontend/map/support/safety still update; future diagnosis remains enabled. This is a feedback mismatch ablation.
definitions.NP: Retains actual shared structural inference, but diagnostic ranking uses before_observation_score. EVI and hypothetical branches can remain in saved logs; their presence does not mean future information was used.

goal_ablation_mapping.actual_feedback: S versus NF removes observed geometry evidence from planning structural belief while preserving perception, map, safety and hypothetical future diagnosis.
goal_ablation_mapping.actual_shared_reliability_belief: NC versus B compares shared versus nonsharing current structural belief, with other-instance future updates excluded effectively in both. This includes downstream forecasts/decisions induced by the current belief; not a scalar-rho-only intervention.
goal_ablation_mapping.cross_instance_future_component: S versus NC removes only other-instance future utility changes; actual shared reliability belief remains enabled.
goal_ablation_mapping.future_information_planning: S versus NP changes diagnostic ranking from expected post-observation to pre-observation value; actual belief feedback remains enabled.
goal_ablation_mapping.whole_candidate_increment: S versus B combines current shared belief and its cross-instance future use; it cannot isolate the two components by itself.

limitations: Saved action/mesh equivalence is descriptive and does not replace each ablation own policy/TSDF replay and full numeric input proof.
No ablation scores imputed from baseline, even for identical saved endpoint arrays.
Six condition-by-ablation slots cover one parent P00 only; conditions and ablations do not add independent parents.
A positive total logged EVI is not a measured cross-instance marginal contribution.
An inactive removed mechanism cannot demonstrate that mechanism is unnecessary in general.
method_control_table_scope: Static frozen source flags. F is included for control-definition completeness, not parsed as an additional trajectory in this diagnostic. Effective columns are source-level capabilities, not claims that the mechanism changed any realized decision.

source_line_anchors.purpose: NF zeros actual geometry messages only in planning belief
Planning instances receive shared posterior; NF removes geometry log scores from planning records
NC freezes non-target future utility using current posterior; NP ranks by pre-observation utility; followup set unchanged
B nonsharing posterior has no peer messages; NC actual posterior includes same-class peer evidence
Hypothetical observation modifies only the target instance evidence
EVI combines each instance expected utility over the same common terminal action set
Common frontend still computes/applies observed geometry feedback and mapping for NF
